packages.title: Dubai City Highlights
packages.shortDescription: The Burj Khalifa, the desert and old Dubai in five unhurried days.
packages.description:
The trip we recommend for a first visit. You see the Dubai everyone pictures, from the 124th floor of the Burj Khalifa to the dunes at sunset, and the older city along the Creek that many visitors miss.

Days are paced so you are never rushing, with a free day for shopping or the beach. Hotels are four-star and central, and every transfer is private.

Dubai Marina skyscrapers glowing in golden light, seen from a boat

Evening desert safari with a dune drive and barbecue dinner

itinerary.description: Our driver meets you at Dubai International and takes you to your hotel. The evening is yours; the Dubai Fountain show at the foot of the Burj Khalifa is a good first stop.

packages.title: Dubai Family Escape
packages.shortDescription: Waterparks, aquariums and theme parks, with easy days in between.
packages.description:
Built around children's energy levels. Big days at Atlantis Aquaventure and IMG Worlds of Adventure alternate with easier ones, so nobody hits a wall by day three.

You stay in a family room at a four-star beach hotel, and our driver handles every transfer. Child seats are available on request.

packages.title: Abu Dhabi & Dubai
packages.shortDescription: The Grand Mosque, the Louvre and Yas Island, then three nights in Dubai.
packages.description:
Two cities, one trip. You start with two nights in Abu Dhabi for its museums and the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, then move to Dubai for the skyline, the souks and the desert.

The drive between them takes about 90 minutes and we handle it, so the only decision left is Ferrari World or Warner Bros. World on Yas Island.

packages.title: Seven Emirates Discovery
packages.shortDescription: Every emirate in one week, from Jebel Jais to the east coast.
packages.description:
Most visitors see two emirates. This trip covers all seven by private car, with nights in Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah and Abu Dhabi.

Expect the country's quieter side: the mountain road up Jebel Jais, the old mosque at Al Bidyah, Sharjah's heritage quarter and the beaches of the east coast.

Al Bidyah Mosque and the Fujairah coast

itinerary.description: Private transfer to your hotel and a free evening to settle in.

itinerary.title: Dubai city and desert
itinerary.description: Morning city tour of old and new Dubai, then an afternoon desert safari with a barbecue dinner at camp.

itinerary.title: Sharjah, Ajman and Umm Al Quwain
itinerary.description: Drive north through Sharjah's Heritage Area and Al Noor Island, stop on Ajman's corniche and at the Umm Al Quwain mangroves, and reach Ras Al Khaimah by evening.

itinerary.title: Jebel Jais
itinerary.description: Up the mountain road to the UAE's highest peak for the viewpoints and cooler air. The Jebel Jais Flight zipline is optional and booked in advance.

itinerary.title: The east coast
itinerary.description: Cross the Hajar Mountains to Dibba and Al Bidyah Mosque, the oldest in the country, then snorkel off Snoopy Island before checking in by the beach.

itinerary.title: Fujairah to Abu Dhabi
itinerary.description: Morning at Fujairah Fort, then the drive west to Abu Dhabi, arriving in time for the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque at sunset.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Abu Dhabi or Dubai airport for your flight home.

packages.title: Malaysia Getaway
packages.shortDescription: Kuala Lumpur's towers, the Batu Caves and a day in the Genting Highlands.
packages.description:
A short trip that still feels full: three nights in Kuala Lumpur, the city's landmarks, the limestone Batu Caves and a cable car ride up to the cool Genting Highlands.

It fits a long weekend from Dubai and works just as well for families, couples or a first trip abroad.

itinerary.description: The King's Palace, the National Monument, Merdeka Square and a photo stop at the Petronas Twin Towers, then the Batu Caves in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Genting Highlands
itinerary.description: A day in the hills, about an hour from the city. Ride the Awana SkyWay cable car, visit the Chin Swee Caves Temple and the theme parks at the top, and come back down by evening.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to KLIA for your flight home. With a late flight, we stop at Putrajaya's pink Putra Mosque, which is on the way.

packages.description:
Singapore is compact, clean and easy to get around, which makes it ideal for a first trip abroad or a family break. This plan covers the essentials without a single rushed day.

Day three is yours to shape: the beaches and cable car on Sentosa, or a full day at Universal Studios Singapore as an upgrade.

packages.title: Phuket & Krabi Islands
packages.shortDescription: Island-hopping on Thailand's Andaman coast, with nights in Phuket and Krabi.
packages.description:
Turquoise water, limestone cliffs and long-tail boats. You split the week between Phuket and Krabi, with a speedboat day to the Phi Phi Islands and a boat trip through Phang Nga Bay.

Hotels are close to the beach, and there is free time in each place for doing nothing at all.

packages.title: Bali Island Escape
packages.shortDescription: Ubud's rice terraces, Nusa Penida's cliffs and sunset at Uluwatu.
packages.description:
Bali in two halves. Three nights in Ubud for temples, rice terraces and the green interior, then two by the sea for beaches, Uluwatu and a day trip to Nusa Penida.

A favourite with honeymooners and just as good with friends. Ask us about private pool villas in Ubud.

packages.title: Georgia: Tbilisi & Kazbegi
packages.shortDescription: Old Tbilisi, the Gergeti church under Mount Kazbek and the ski slopes of Gudauri.
packages.description:
Three hours from Dubai and on the same clock, Georgia is the easiest mountain holiday you can take from the UAE. Tbilisi has the old town, sulphur baths and wine bars; the Caucasus has the rest.

The highlight is the drive up the Georgian Military Road, past Ananuri fortress and Gudauri, to the Gergeti Trinity Church at 2,170 metres.
packages.bestTime: May to October, or December to March for snow

itinerary.title: Kazbegi and the Military Road
itinerary.description: A full day in the Caucasus: Ananuri fortress, Gudauri and the Friendship Monument, then a 4x4 up to the Gergeti Trinity Church above Stepantsminda. Back in Tbilisi by evening.

packages.title: Azerbaijan: Baku & Gabala
packages.shortDescription: Baku's Flame Towers and walled old city, with a night in the mountains of Gabala.
packages.description:
About three hours from Dubai, Baku pairs a walled medieval old town with some of the boldest modern architecture in the region. A night in Gabala's forests and mountains rounds it off.

A good choice for families and groups, and one of the best-value trips we run.

packages.title: Istanbul & Cappadocia
packages.shortDescription: Istanbul's mosques and bazaars, then cave hotels and sunrise balloons in Cappadocia.
packages.description:
Two very different sides of Turkey. Istanbul has Byzantine churches, Ottoman mosques and the Bosphorus; Cappadocia has fairy chimneys, underground cities and nights in a cave hotel.

The flight between them takes about 80 minutes. The sunrise balloon flight is optional but worth it, and we book it as soon as you confirm.

itinerary.description: A morning flight to Kayseri and the transfer to your cave hotel in Göreme. Sunset from the viewpoints above town.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia's valleys
itinerary.description: The optional balloon flight at sunrise, then the Göreme Open Air Museum, Uçhisar castle, the fairy chimneys of Pasabag and the Derinkuyu underground city.

itinerary.title: Back to Istanbul
itinerary.description: Fly back to Istanbul for a final evening. Dinner by the water is a good way to end the trip.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight home.

inclusions: 4 nights in Istanbul and 2 nights in a Cappadocia cave hotel, with breakfast
Return domestic flights between Istanbul and Kayseri
All airport transfers
Guided tour of old Istanbul with entry tickets
Bosphorus cruise
Full-day Cappadocia tour with lunch
exclusions: Turkey visa or e-visa, if your passport needs one
Hot-air balloon flight, quoted on request

packages.title: Maldives Overwater Retreat
packages.shortDescription: Three nights in a water villa, with breakfast and dinner every day.
packages.description:
Four hours from Dubai and one hour ahead, with nothing to plan once you land. You stay in an overwater villa at a four-star resort, with half board and speedboat transfers from Malé.

Ideal for honeymoons and anniversaries. Tell us the occasion when you book and we will let the resort know.

hero.alt: Thatched overwater villa with a private pool over a turquoise lagoon

highlights: An overwater villa with steps into the lagoon
Breakfast and dinner every day
Snorkelling on the house reef
A sunset dolphin cruise
Return speedboat transfers from Malé

itinerary.title: Arrive in Malé
itinerary.description: The resort team meets you at Velana airport for the speedboat to your island. Check in to your water villa and settle in.

itinerary.title: Reef and lagoon
itinerary.description: A free day. Snorkel the house reef, kayak or paddleboard on the lagoon, or book a spa treatment.

itinerary.title: Sunset dolphin cruise
itinerary.description: Another slow day, then an evening boat trip to look for spinner dolphins as the sun goes down.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Speedboat back to Malé for your flight home.

inclusions: 3 nights in an overwater villa at a 4-star resort
Breakfast and dinner daily
Return speedboat transfers from Malé
Sunset dolphin cruise
Snorkelling equipment
Taxes and the Maldives green tax
exclusions: Seaplane transfers, where the resort needs them
